column1: > Figure registry. One row per FIGURE SET: the output directory, the script that
> writes it, the exact argv, and whether its point colour uses the reversibility-
> transition categories (so a change to that definition can be regenerated by
> group). Lines starting with '>' are comments.
>     python3 scripts/regen_figures.py --tag transition       # only the coloured scatters
> Adding a new figure: add a row here in the same call that creates the script.
> An unregistered figure is a figure nobody can regenerate.
